<Speaker 1>When it comes to the neural TTS, in order to get a good voice, it's better to have good data.

<Speaker 2>To achieve that, we build a universal TTS model based on 3,000 hours of data.

<Speaker 3>What we liked about cognitive services offerings were that they had a much higher fidelity.

00:29.630 --> 00:32.910
<Speaker 3>And they sounded a lot more like an actual human voice.

Summary.valueString: The video opens with a Flight Simulator plane flying over an island, introducing a collaboration with Microsoft Azure AI. A man in glasses explains the importance of good data for neural TTS (text-to-speech) and describes building a universal TTS model trained on 3,000 hours of data to capture audio nuances and generate natural voices. Visuals show audio waveforms and a data center, emphasizing the scale and technology behind the model. The scene transitions to scenic aerial views from the flight simulator, showcasing detailed landscapes and castles, highlighting the realism of the simulation. Another man discusses the high fidelity of cognitive services' voices, noting how they sound more human. The segment ends with realistic airport ground operations and an airplane preparing for pushback, accompanied by simulated air traffic control communications.
